Line.zh:
A man approaches and greets you. He introduces himself as a travelling trader from a town far to the west.
He says he passes through the forest every spring and autumn, and thought he would stop by to introduce himself.
He will be setting up at the Green Glade, and invites you to visit if you have anything to trade.
